subject: Collection hold: Deferred payment + unallocated prefetch usage
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia@omniflow.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@omniflow.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Collection hold: Deferred payment + unallocated prefetch usage

Hi Aditya,

We placed our invoice for August on hold this morning while our finance team investigates an unexpected ~48% jump in per-prefix prefetch requests that show up on the 17:00-19:00 UTC window. The billing line items reference "prefetch" and a few sessions that we do not recognize (tenant id mismatch).

We need two things from Redwood to unblock payment:
- A CSV sample of raw request-level records for the 2026-08-17 17:00:00 - 2026-08-17 19:00:00 UTC window (request id, api_key, route, model_variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, prefix_tag)
- A short summary explaining why these requests would be attributed to our account (we do not have any SDK changes, and our infra shows no test runs).

I attached a small spreadsheet with the invoice line reference and highlighted rows that triggered the hold. For compliance we put the whole invoice into collection hold until we have evidence; please treat this as urgent — our billing deadline is 2026-09-05 and we may escalate to procurement if not resolved.

Attachments (mentioned): invoice_line_refs.xlsx (stub), sample_highlight.csv (stub)

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Head of Finance — Omniflow
olivia@omniflow.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@omniflow.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 10:30:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Collection hold: Deferred payment + unallocated prefetch usage

Hi Olivia — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the invoice snippet. We're sorry for the disruption.

Quick plan of action:
1) I've requested a targeted export of raw request-level telemetry for the exact two-hour window you referenced and will deliver a CSV sample (anonymized where appropriate) within 24 hours.
2) Ben (cc) will engage Billing Ops to check attribution rules and whether any cross-tenant keying or legacy api_key reuse could explain the tenant id mismatch.
3) Kimberly (cc) will prepare a provisional credit pathway if we find the usage was misattributed. We can put a provisional voucher on your account to prevent collections activity while we investigate.

For the export we will include: request_id, api_key_hash (masked), route, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, prefix_tag, and the raw timestamp. Can you confirm we may provide masked api_key hashes instead of full keys? Also please confirm the invoice line IDs you want prioritized (I see #A-1234 and #A-1237 highlighted in your sample).

I'll follow up with the CSV as soon as Billing Ops completes the pull.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@omniflow.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 11:08:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Collection hold: Deferred payment + unallocated prefetch usage

Hi Olivia — looping in Billing Ops and Collections (internal ticket created).

A couple of operational notes so we're aligned on expectations:
- We'll deliver the initial 24-hour CSV sample by EOD Pacific 2026-08-31 (already in progress).
- If the sample confirms misattribution, we can issue a provisional credit equal to the disputed lines and apply a voucher while engineering completes root cause (typical turnaround 3 business days).
- If attribution is confirmed to Omniflow, we'll provide a short forensic explanation and raw log excerpts showing caller headers and model variant.

Can you confirm whether Omniflow has rotated any SDK keys or issued any short-lived test keys in August? That would help narrow causes quickly. If you prefer, we can also schedule a 30-minute screenshare with your infra folks + our telemetry team to step through the samples.

Also attaching a stub of the usage export we will send (filename: usage_sample_202608-window.csv).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Olivia Chen <olivia@omniflow.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@omniflow.com
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2026 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Collection hold: Deferred payment + unallocated prefetch usage

Thanks, Ben and Aditya — appreciate the quick response.

We reviewed the CSV sample you provided and it shows a cluster of prefetch requests originating from an api_key that matches our internal naming convention but with a different prefix_tag. Our infra team discovered a temporary CI job that rotated a service key on 2026-08-17 — Ive attached the signed PO for the mid-cycle change and the CI job log excerpt where the key was used.

Next steps from Omniflow:
- We will lift the collection hold once Redwood provides a short attribution memo showing the api_key hash and the matching timestamp cluster (so our auditors have the reconciliation).
- We uploaded a signed PO for the mid-cycle change (signed_po_omniflow_20260901.pdf stub) to your Drive link and included the CI excerpt (prefetch-log-sample.txt stub).

Please confirm when youve posted the reconciliation memo and whether you will apply a voucher or simply mark this as legitimate usage. Wed prefer a voucher while our internal audit completes.

Olivia Chen
Head of Finance — Omniflow
olivia@omniflow.com
